notes.title: Game.exe V1.5 Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Today we updated some things on Game.exe:
- Changed splash image
- Now the achievements are given as soon as you complete them instead of after closing the game

Thanks so much for the support and STAY PUNX!

Our website

notes.title: Quality of life update
notes.notes:
- Reduced the chance and frequency of being hacked
- Reduced the monster speed from 4.5 to 4
- Minor optimizations
- Still working on a localization update...

notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.notes:
Changes:

- Performance stabilizations
- Disabled the framerate cap of 30 FPS
- Minor bug fixes

The localization update is going through a lot of changes, as soon as I come up with something solid I will make sure to let you guys know!

notes.title: Small update v1.1
notes.notes:
Regarding recent feedback, I decided to change and fix some things!
- When the timer runs out the game no longer closes, it only restarts.
- When you die, you're not locked out of the game, it only restarts.
- You now have 60 seconds of time instead of 45.
